Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Dams Denna]] ("Collector of Linn'con memorabilia"): Abraham Lincoln, photographed by Alexander Gardner in Washington, D.C., on 8 November 1863. Reduced to 960 by 1237 pixels.

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abraham_Lincoln_O-77_matte_collodion_print.jpg Abraham Lincoln O-77 matte collodion print.jpg], Wikimedia Commons. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027170104/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Abraham_Lincoln_O-77_matte_collodion_print.jpg Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

Photographer: Alexander Gardner (1821–1882).

License: Public domain. The photograph was published in 1863 and its author died in 1882, so it is in the public domain in the United States and in countries where copyright lasts the author's life plus 100 years or less.
